verses.text: Brothers and sisters, you know yourselves that our visit to you was not wasted.

Before that, as you know, we had suffered and been treated shamefully in Philippi. But with the help of our God we were brave enough to tell you God's Good News, even though many people were against us.
What we urged you to believe did not come from mistakes, or from impure reasons, and we were not trying to trick you.
Instead, God tested us and trusted us with the Good News, so that is how we speak. We are not trying to please people, but God, who tests our hearts.
As you know, we never used flattering words. We never used a false face to hide greed. God is our witness.
We were not looking for praise from people, not from you or from anyone else. As apostles of Christ we could have demanded things from you.
But we were gentle among you, like a mother caring for her own little children.
We cared so much for you that we were happy to share with you not only God's Good News, but our own lives too, because you had become very dear to us.
Brothers and sisters, you remember how hard we worked and struggled. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you while we preached God's Good News to you.
You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, right and without blame we were towards you who believe.
You know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children. We urged you, comforted you and begged you
to live in a way that is worthy of God, who calls you into his own kingdom and glory.

And we also thank God all the time for this: when you received God's message from us, you accepted it not as a human message, but as what it truly is, God's word. And it is at work in you who believe.
Brothers and sisters, you followed the example of God's churches in Judea that belong to Christ Jesus. You suffered the same things from your own people as those churches suffered from the Jews.
Those Jews killed the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and they drove us out. They do not please God, and they are against all people.
They try to stop us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they can be saved. In this way they keep adding to their sins. But in the end God's anger has come on them.
Brothers and sisters, we were taken away from you for a short time, in body but not in heart. We wanted so much to see you face to face that we tried all the harder.
We wanted to come to you. I, Paul, tried again and again, but Satan stopped us.
What is our hope, our joy, the crown we will be proud of in front of our Lord Jesus when he comes? Is it not you?
Yes, you are our glory and our joy.
